instruction: Configure Apache mod_ratelimit per virtual host
output:
a2enmod ratelimit && echo -e '<Location /downloads>
  SetOutputFilter RATE_LIMIT
  SetEnv rate-limit 400
</Location>' >> /etc/apache2/sites-available/default.conf && systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Enable Apache mod_proxy_balancer with sticky sessions
output:
a2enmod proxy_balancer lbmethod_byrequests && cat > /etc/apache2/sites-available/balancer.conf << 'EOF'
<Proxy balancer://mycluster>
  BalancerMember http://192.168.1.10:80 route=node1
  BalancerMember http://192.168.1.11:80 route=node2
  ProxySet stickysession=ROUTEID
</Proxy>
<VirtualHost *:80>
  ProxyPass / balancer://mycluster/
</VirtualHost>
EOF && a2ensite balancer && systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Set up Apache with mod_cache_disk
output:
a2enmod cache cache_disk && echo -e '<IfModule mod_cache_disk.c>
  CacheRoot /var/cache/apache2/mod_cache_disk
  CacheEnable disk /
  CacheHeader on
</IfModule>' >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && mkdir -p /var/cache/apache2/mod_cache_disk && systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Configure Apache mod_deflate for compression
output:
a2enmod deflate && cat > /etc/apache2/conf-available/deflate.conf << 'EOF'
AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript
BrowserMatch ^Mozilla/4 gzip-only-text/html
BrowserMatch ^Mozilla/4\\.0[678] no-gzip
EOF && a2enconf deflate && systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Set up Apache mod_qos for connection limiting
output: apt install -y libapache2-mod-qos && echo -e 'QS_SrvMaxConn 100\nQS_SrvMaxConnClose 80\nQS_SrvMinDataRate 120 1500' >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && systemctl restart apache2
